TCC Website Features 0.10.0: church logo on sign-in and Dashboard tidy-up, writer names in search

- New feature "Church logo on the sign-in page and a tidier Dashboard" does what the AGCA plugin did: the church logo on the sign-in page (now linked to the website), rounded sign-in box, no Register link, the logo at the top of the admin menu, rounded pop-out menus, and the unused Dashboard boxes and Help tab hidden.
- Sitewide search now finds pieces by their writer's name (what WP Extended Search used to add), leaving out the church's own and other non-person accounts.
- Help tab and AI prompts updated. On staging, AGCA, WP Extended Search and Divi Search Helper are switched off.
